convention: Within one key, the first listed fact is the headline fact used for case_lead_times and scenarios: the most precise date, then a primary source. Further facts under the same key are alternatives or disagreements, kept and never averaged. An iso_date ending in Z is UTC. An iso_date with a time and no Z is local time as the source reports it. A date of YYYY or YYYY-MM has that precision only, and null means the source gives no calendar date. Quotes keep the page language.

cases.name: Heimaey (Eldfell) 1973
cases.no_pdc_reason: No pyroclastic density current is reported in any source read for this case. Einarsson 2018 describes a fissure eruption next to the town, and the Eldfell article describes lava flows, tephra fall and gas, with no mention of pyroclastic flows. This is absence from these sources, not a statement by them that none occurred.

cases.name: Tajogaite, Cumbre Vieja, La Palma 2021
cases.no_pdc_reason: No pyroclastic density current is reported for this eruption in any source read. Bonadonna et al. 2023 classify its explosive styles as ash-poor gas puffing, Strombolian, violent Strombolian and lava fountaining, and mention pyroclastic density currents only as a feature of other hybrid eruptions. This is absence from these sources, not a statement by them that none occurred.
